label: CU loop • the feed names each element by role, label and app, and never stores typed text
query: Address the reply to sam.rivera@example.com and send it.
notes: Deterministic (scripted-model) case for the action audit: the model addresses controls by mark only, but every propose, act and gate event in the stored feed names the resolved element (`textfield "To"`, `button "Send"`) and the app. The typed address appears in no feed title: the feed records its length, and the text itself is shown only on the confirm card. Under `trusted` the Send commit confirms, so the gate events are covered too.
